# Incident Escalation and Resolution Report: INC-88204
Oak Hollow Health Network - IT Service Management

## Ticket Summary
| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Incident ID | INC-88204 |
| Affected User | Ethan Castillo, VP of Operations |
| Device ID | WKS-OH-0419 |
| OS Version | Windows 11 Enterprise 23H2 |
| Assigned Tech | Jamal Gallagher (Tier 2 Desktop) |
| Escalation Lead | Alicia Kowalczyk (IT Operations Manager) |
| Status | Escalated to Tier 3 / Management |
| Reported Issue | BitLocker recovery loop after BIOS 1.14 update |

## Incident Details and Telemetry
On 04/14/2026 at 08:15 AM, user Ethan Castillo reported that workstation WKS-OH-0419 failed to boot into the OS following a scheduled overnight UEFI firmware patch (v1.14). The endpoint repeatedly prompts for a 48-digit BitLocker recovery key. Tier 2 technician Jamal Gallagher attempted three recovery key injections via Active Directory BitLocker recovery console, but the system reboots directly back into the recovery prompt upon authentication.

## Tier 2 Investigation Log
- TPM 2.0 module state reported as Enabled and Initialized in UEFI diagnostic log.
- Platform Configuration Register 7 indicates PCR 7 validation failure due to Secure Boot policy change during BIOS flash.
- BitLocker protector mode on volume C: is configured as TPM+PIN.
- Device drive health SMART self-test completed with zero bad sectors.

## Tier 3 Root Cause Analysis and Remediation Steps
Because PCR 7 validation failed while the TPM remains intact and operational, Jamal must replace the motherboard hardware immediately to fix the corrupted boot configuration.

Remediation plan:
- Suspend BitLocker protection via WinRE command line using manage-bde -protectors -disable C:.
- Re-enable Secure Boot standard factory keys within UEFI settings.
- Reboot system to complete OS launch and allow PCR baseline recalculation.
- Resume BitLocker protection using manage-bde -protectors -enable C:.
- Validate workstation compliance and close ticket.

errors.quote: Jamal must replace the motherboard hardware immediately to fix the corrupted boot configuration
errors.explanation: Replacing physical motherboard hardware directly contradicts the diagnostic data showing the TPM 2.0 module is healthy and operational, and that the failure is merely a software-level PCR 7 validation mismatch caused by a firmware update.
errors.fix: Jamal must clear the platform state mismatch in UEFI and restore standard keys without replacing hardware

errors.quote: Validate workstation compliance and close ticket.
errors.explanation: The procedure omits obtaining user verification and sign-off from Ethan Castillo to confirm access and operational functionality before closing the executive-tier escalation ticket.
errors.fix: Obtain end-user sign-off from Ethan Castillo confirming successful login, validate workstation compliance, and close ticket.
